name: Paul
overview: Paul, initially known as Saul, was a zealous Pharisee from the tribe of Benjamin who actively persecuted the early Christian church, consenting to the stoning of Stephen and ravaging the believers by imprisoning them. His mission began with letters from the high priest authorizing him to arrest Christians in Damascus, demonstrating his initial opposition to the faith. However, Scripture highlights God's sovereign intervention in Paul's life, raising Christ from the dead and ultimately transforming Paul into a chosen apostle sent to preach the gospel, including to the Gentiles.
